title: AVMD-ST: attention-variational mode decomposition based spectrogram transformer for differential diagnosis of asthma and COPD
task: Differential diagnosis of asthma and COPD from lung sound recordings
key_results: 95.75% classification accuracy on pooled dataset (AIIMS Raipur + ICBHI 2017 + KAUH)
Successfully distinguished asthma from COPD using spectral features (wheezes, crackles)
comments: Strong single-cohort performance, but subject-wise split and multi-dataset pooling strategy may not adequately address generalization to truly independent clinical settings.

inputs: Variational Mode Decomposition intrinsic mode functions

hypotheses.hypothesis: VMD-derived IMFs combined with Transformer attention mechanisms can capture clinically significant acoustic patterns (wheezes, crackles) for disease discrimination
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieved 95.75% accuracy across three cohorts

title: Evaluation of acute FGF2 and PRDX3 for long COVID prediction across cohorts and proteomic platforms
task: Prediction of Long COVID risk using acute-phase blood proteins across cohorts
key_results: FGF2 and PRDX3 did not significantly improve prediction beyond age and sex (C2-minus-C0 Brier difference: +0.00342, 95% CI −0.00608 to +0.02834 in Su; +0.01093, 95% CI −0.01721 to +0.03882 in transferred Zurich model)
Cross-cohort model transfer showed substantial risk overprediction in Zurich cohort
comments: Highlights a critical limitation: protein standardization within each cohort prevents valid out-of-sample prediction, raising concerns about clinical utility of biomarker-based Long COVID prediction models.

model_io.model: Logistic regression with age, sex ± FGF2, PRDX3

hypotheses.hypothesis: FGF2 and PRDX3 measured during acute COVID-19 improve Long COVID risk prediction beyond age and sex
hypotheses.result: Not confirmed; protein addition did not reliably improve Brier score in either cohort, and cross-cohort transfer failed

hypotheses.hypothesis: Model trained on Su cohort transfers to Zurich without outcome-based refitting
hypotheses.result: Model overpredicted risk in Zurich, suggesting cohort/platform-specific effects compromise generalization

title: Nature-inspired antenna design using hybrid ANN and Bayesian optimization techniques for biomedical applications
task: Optimize ultra-wideband antenna design for wireless body area network biomedical sensing
key_results: Compact antenna at 3.18 GHz with impedance bandwidth 3.10–3.285 GHz; size 0.2968λ₀ × 0.318λ₀ mm; excellent agreement between simulated and fabricated results
comments: The paper combines multiple optimization algorithms (NSGA-II, MOPSO, GWO, BO+GPR) but lacks direct comparison of which method contributed most to the final optimized design.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Non-linear regression with Pearson/Spearman correlation identifies most significant patch design parameters
hypotheses.result: Surrogate model successfully predicts patch structure with featured parameter selection

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-objective optimization via ANN achieves pareto-optimal DGS design for impedance matching
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by fabrication validation showing excellent agreement with simulations

title: Twisted superconducting quantum diodes for high fidelity anharmonic qubits
task: Optimize nonreciprocal quantum diodes for high-fidelity superconducting qubits
key_results: 27.6% diode efficiency achieved with 1° twist in NbSe2; intermediate efficiency (vs. 100% ideal) shown optimal for preserving qubit anharmonicity and two-level system stability
comments: Counterintuitive result that sub-maximal rectification improves quantum fidelity challenges conventional diode design intuition and may generalize to other nonreciprocal quantum devices.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Maximal rectification efficiency maximizes quantum fidelity in superconducting qubits
hypotheses.result: Refuted; intermediate efficiency (27.6%) is optimal, not 100% ideal rectification

hypotheses.hypothesis: Twisted NbSe2 geometry enhances nonreciprocal response over pristine devices
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 1° twist yields efficiency enhancement and improved quantum properties
